name: Phlegethos
title: Phlegethos: The Fourth Layer
description: Phlegethos is the fourth layer of the Nine Hells, a volcanic wasteland complete with lava rivers and fires that burn even without fuel.
wiki: Phlegethos is a place of eternal fire and torture. It is ruled jointly by the Archduchess Fierna and her father, Archduke Belial, from the city of Abriymoch.
